old: Zooming required holding Ctrl while scrolling the mouse wheel
new: Zooming can be performed by holding the wheel button while scrolling or by enabling the preference that makes the scroll wheel zoom without holding Ctrl; the right button + wheel will no longer zoom but will pan the canvas
evidence_quote: You can zoom with just the mouse now (#12099): hold the wheel button while scrolling, or set Preferences → Input → "Mouse" so the scroll wheel zooms without holding Ctrl. We won't map right button + wheel to zoom, because dragging with the right button now pans the canvas (#12110).
